sha.description: git rev-parse --short=10 HEAD as measured by this agent; the scan's resumability test reads changes since it

slug.description: the candidate slug exactly as the prompt listed it; names the proposal file

file.description: repo-relative path of the file that loses tests (for a group candidate, the first one the disposition edits)

kind.description: retire = delete examples or stories whose every assertion is pinned elsewhere (target names where; with no surviving owner it is keep); consolidate = fold a repeated matrix or repeated stories into the one surface that owns the mechanism, keeping one wiring case per consumer; detag = take a no-play story file out of the test-storybook run with the render-only tag (it renders and snapshots, but runs no play); hoist-ddl = an rspec example pinning presence, uniqueness, or a foreign key that db/schema.rb already enforces moves to a one-line schema assertion; keep = the candidate is expensive or repeated for a reason that holds — evidence says what that reason is

target.description: where the surviving assertion lives after the change: file plus example or export name; empty only for keep, and for a detag that removes no export; the apply gate refuses a proposal that removes examples and leaves it empty

evidence.description: one line a human reads in the apply dialog: the measured count and the code fact that decides it

estimated_seconds.description: suite seconds this saves, an order-of-magnitude figure from the most recent run's per-file times scaled by the share of examples removed; 0 for keep; null for storybook when no full junit report exists

examples_removed.description: GROSS examples (rspec) or story exports (storybook) the change deletes or folds away, re-derived by reading the file, whether or not a copy is added back elsewhere (a consolidate that moves 3 and drops 1 is 4); the apply gate checks baseline minus this plus the hoisted additions equals the post-change count

removed.description: every it description or story export name the change deletes or folds, one entry per removed example (at least examples_removed entries); the apply gate checks the consolidation ledger names each one exactly

governing_rule.description: the rule file and section that licenses this disposition, e.g. .claude/rules/storybook.md § A shared mechanism is pinned once

mechanical.description: true only when the change is a deletion or move with no open question — no product decision, no coverage judgment a reviewer could dispute; false files the item as a needs-decision Linear issue instead of applying it

mutation.description: for each deleted routing arm, the one-line mutation of the implementation the surviving assertion must redden against (file, line or symbol, the swap); required whenever examples_removed is above 0; empty for detag and keep

report.description: full markdown write-up: what was re-derived, the matrix and where it is already pinned, the survivor, the ledger lines, risks
